title: Big scam!
body:
Warning: You will NOT be able to cancel your subscription by yourself!
Be very careful with this app. You cannot cancel the subscription on your own – you have to contact their support team.
At first, they reply after 2–3 days, only to tell you that “it’s written in small print when you enter your card details.”
Then they try to keep you by offering a so-called bonus (which they claim is worth $97).
But after that? No reply at all.
I’ve sent multiple emails and got completely ignored.

This is not how serious companies treat their users.
I strongly do not recommend this app unless you’re ready for unnecessary frustration and hidden policies
